messages:
Alex: quick check — APAC vendor just messaged: they can free up 10x H100 slots tomorrow morning in `asia-southeast1`. can we claim them for the demo pool?
Mira: thanks — what window are they available?
Alex: says 06:00-12:00 UTC. vendor noted short notice, serials TBD.
Kevin: we might need only 4 for canary, but grabbing all 10 as reserve would be great if billing + procurement ok. cc @SRE-Oncall for routing.
VendorBot: Vendor update: 10 H100s allocated to account RH-774. ETA: 2026-03-19 06:00 UTC. Serial numbers will be posted by 02:00 UTC on provisioning day.
SRE-Oncall: ping — we need to ensure network RDMA + MTU settings for those racks. Do we have a Terraform reservation ready?
Jamie: I started a draft TF for reservation; snippet:```hcl
resource "google_compute_resource_policy" "gpu_reserve" {
  name = "redwood-apac-h100-demo-reserve"
  region = "asia-southeast1"
  // placeholder
}
```
Alex: perfect. Kevin — do you want me to provision the full 10 into a new dedicated pool or temp attach to demo pool?
Kevin: temp attach to demo pool first. If demo usage spikes, we can move 6 -> dedicated. Need quota bump approved for the account though.
Mira: procurement question — contract says vendor can only hold slots 24 hours without invoice. Can finance sign off on same-day invoice? @Jamie
Jamie: finance is OK with one-off invoice, but need PO reference. I can request PO, will take ~2 hours.
SRE-Oncall: ops checklist: 1) Ensure BGP sessions to vendor fabric 2) Validate RDMA kernel 3) preflight MIG/driver image 4) update canary routing policy in console. Who owns image?
Alex: @Mira owns image. Mira — can you push a canary image to staging and share digest?
Mira: uploading now. digest: `sha256:9f4a...b2c`. image includes kernel 6.1 + rdma driver 5.4.
VendorBot: Serial update: will post serials by 02:00 UTC, includes rack IDs and power profiles.
Kevin: once serials arrive, I will open a ticket with vendor to confirm power/cooling constraints. Also need to check reserved IP pool size — might need +256 IPs.
Alex: if we only use 4, can we set up prefix/KV cache warmers before traffic? want to avoid cold-start latency during demo.
Mira: yep, I'll run a warmup job after attach. script: `./scripts/warmup_kv.sh --pool demo --concurrency 8`
SRE-Oncall: small nit — ensure jenkins job has `max_attempts=5` and alerting on OOMs. I'll add a temporary pager rota for the window.
Jamie: PO requested, vendor billing contact looped. ETA for PO approval: 90 minutes.
Alex: timeline summary: vendor holds til 06:00 UTC tomorrow, PO in ~90m, TF reserve drafted, image pushed. next steps: Jamie to confirm PO, Kevin to verify IP/power, SRE to prep network, Mira to run warmup. thumbs? :thumbsup:
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Mira: :thumbsup:
SRE-Oncall: I'll be oncall during window. Adding note to incident runbook.
VendorBot: Reminder will be sent 3 hours before provisioning window.
Alex: thanks everyone — will update if anything changes.
